name: Luminance
summary: Contract intelligence platform for drafting, negotiating and analysing contracts across the enterprise.
description: Luminance provides a contract intelligence platform used by legal teams and other business functions. It reviews, drafts and negotiates contracts and turns contract language into searchable data to manage risk and obligations across the organisation. Access is through a demo request, and no public prices are listed. The company publishes a report on the state of contract intelligence. Its security and customer pages describe use beyond the legal department.

howToUse.title: Open Luminance
howToUse.description: Open Luminance and request a demo to reach the contract intelligence platform.

howToUse.title: Review, draft and negotiate
howToUse.description: Bring a contract into the platform so it reviews, drafts and negotiates from your precedent and playbooks.

howToUse.title: Search obligations
howToUse.description: Turn contract language into searchable data, then manage risk and obligations across legal teams and other business functions in the organisation.

howToUse.title: Read the report and customer pages
howToUse.description: Open the report on the state of contract intelligence, then use the security and customer pages to see use beyond the legal department.
